Grid-Level Land Cover Percentage Composition and Feature Segmentation

Source: R/grids.R
d4h_grid_composition.Rd

Computes the percentage composition of physical features (houses/buildings, water bodies, vegetation canopy, bare soil) across each operational grid cell, providing granular sectoral profiles for micro-environmental surveillance.

Usage

d4h_grid_composition(
  grid,
  water = NULL,
  buildings = NULL,
  ndvi_raster = NULL,
  veg_threshold = 0.3,
  soil_threshold = 0.15,
  out_xlsx = NULL
)

Arguments

grid

SpatVector, sf, or character path. Operational surveillance grid (e.g. from d4h_hex_grid or d4h_summarize_grid).

water

SpatVector, sf, or SpatRaster (optional). Segmented water body polygons or binary water raster.

buildings

SpatVector, sf, or SpatRaster (optional). Segmented dwelling/building footprints or binary roof raster.

ndvi_raster

SpatRaster or character path (optional). NDVI continuous raster to determine vegetation and bare soil cover.

veg_threshold

Numeric. NDVI threshold above which pixels are categorized as vegetation (default: 0.3).

soil_threshold

Numeric. NDVI upper threshold below which non-water pixels are categorized as bare soil (default: 0.15).

out_xlsx

Character (optional). File path to export a structured Excel spreadsheet.

Value

An sf object with appended columns: area_m2, pct_casas, pct_agua, pct_vegetacion, pct_suelo_desnudo, n_casas, n_cuerpos_agua, clase_dominante, and prioridad_vigilancia.

Details

Intersects vector feature boundaries or raster masks with square/hexagonal grid cells: $$\text{Pct}_{\text{class}} = \frac{\text{Area}_{\text{class} \cap \text{Cell}_k}}{\text{Area}_{\text{Cell}_k}} \times 100$$ Computes individual coverage metrics (pct_casas, pct_agua, pct_vegetacion, pct_suelo_desnudo), identifies the dominant land cover class, and assigns intervention priority tiers based on the co-occurrence of dwellings and standing water habitats.
